cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've started investigating the broken vase. First, we check the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you got glue on your fingers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Excellent clue. I'll inspect the glue cupboard personally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A piece of vase is stuck to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put me in charge of preserving it.

mechanism: A hides vase culpability by treating incriminating glue and a shard as evidence only A is qualified to preserve, correcting B investigation methods.
confusable: Ordinary detective play lacks A own culpability becoming visible while A eagerly diverts its meaning into a professional task.
comparison: Plant alternative investigates a harmful drink rather than a visibly attached fragment.
seedUse: Vase seed supplies sticky fingers and attached shard; S03 must turn these into precise evidence-handling corrections rather than generic enthusiasm alone.
